summary: Full e2e verification of the new /kitchen tablet feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass in backend/tests/test_kitchen_flow.py covering kitchen login (success/fail/me), admin-can-login-via-kitchen, kitchen token 403 on /api/admin/orders, /api/kitchen/orders shape, accept flow (moves order to accepted+status=accepted, kitchen_print_status='print_failed' with 'print_bridge_not_configured' as expected while KITCHEN_PRINT_ENDPOINT is unset, print_attempts incremented), accept idempotency (2nd call returns already_decided=true and does NOT re-increment print_attempts), decline flow with reason (moves to declined, status=cancelled), decline idempotency, retry-print 400 when not accepted, retry-print on accepted (ok=false + attempts>=2), reprint (manual_reprint=true), regression: admin GET /api/admin/orders/{id} reflects accepted/cancelled after kitchen actions, admin PUT status pipeline still works, public menu + /restaurant/status still respond. Frontend: playwright script against the real preview URL verified /kitchen redirects unauthenticated -> /kitchen/login, wrong password stays on login (401), correct login redirects to /kitchen, connection status shows 'En ligne', all three tabs + sound + logout buttons render, a live order created via /api/checkout/session appeared in the Nouvelles tab within ~6s via 4s polling (no manual refresh), card correctly showed order number, time, A EMPORTER badge, customer name+phone, item line 2× Cheese with 'Sans oignon' notes badge, client note 'frontend UI test' in red-bordered box, total 8.00 €, 'Espèces sur place' payment, pickup code. Accept & Imprimer moved the order to Acceptées with 'Échec impression' badge (expected per unset bridge), 'Réessayer l'impression' button was clickable and did not crash. Decline flow: dialog opened, reason typed, confirm moved order to Refusées with reason visible. Logout returned to /kitchen/login. Test orders cleaned up via DELETE /api/admin/orders/{id}, original hours restored via PUT /api/settings.
critical_code_review_comments: kitchen_receipt._line uses ascii 'replace' but the module already does _ascii(...) beforehand for user-provided text — safe. Just a minor duplication of intent.

Kitchen.jsx uses `bt-btn-primary` (a red bg) for both accept and retry — visually consistent but the retry-print red button next to the red 'Échec impression' badge on the accepted tab is a lot of red; consider making retry a secondary/ghost style for better visual hierarchy. Non-blocking.

Accept endpoint response nests order under `result['order']` in _print_and_record but decline endpoint returns `'order': updated` where `updated` is already the finalized order dict (from _finalize_order_status). Shapes are consistent — verified by tests — but worth documenting the response schema.

Restaurant hours_per_day was temporarily widened to 00:00-23:59 for all days via PUT /api/settings and restored to original values in the ensure_open fixture teardown / frontend cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kitchen feature is fully functional end-to-end against the simulated (bridge_not_configured) print state. When KITCHEN_PRINT_ENDPOINT is eventually set in backend/.env pointing to a real Android bridge, only the accept/retry/reprint success paths change (kitchen_print_status becomes 'printed', ok=true). All idempotency, auth-scoping (kitchen role 403 on admin endpoints), and admin-status pipeline sharing are wired correctly. test_kitchen_flow.py is safe to re-run and self-cleans (widens hours, creates orders, deletes them, restores hours).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this feature.
